decisions.ELD-03: Applied: [LIMA_BOUNDARIES.md](LIMA_BOUNDARIES.md#frozen-namespace-configuration-eld-03) specifies a concrete v1 boundary: absent/empty namespace globals only, no silent edits to shared files, retained presence/digests and consumed dependencies, separate creation-base provenance, pre/post-dispatch drift checks and conservative refusal. Native instance YAML remains supported within its recorded boundaries.
decisions.ELD-04: Applied: [LIMA_BOUNDARIES.md](LIMA_BOUNDARIES.md#vm-ssh-host-key-trust-eld-04) defines local endpoint trust-on-first-use with an explicit local-host assumption, imported pins, deferred stopped-VM enrollment, authoritative trust generations, strict owned SSH configuration/exports, mismatch refusal and explicit replacement repair. Diagnostics never enroll; Lima internal bootstrap is not misrepresented as pinned.
decisions.ELD-05: Applied: [LIMA_BOUNDARIES.md](LIMA_BOUNDARIES.md#explicit-application-port-forwarding-eld-05) defines approved mappings followed by the exact catch-all ignore rule, explicit GRPC backend for persistent TCP/UDP mappings, localhost address/port/protocol accounting, the separate SSH transport, and pre-retirement refusal of incompatible adopted rules.
